learnerStatement: Simulated learner. This review finds problems; it is not evidence that anyone learned.
learnerBoundary: Everyday numeracy, simple charts, comparing numbers and familiar household objects; no domain-specific theory assumed.

observations.prediction: Selected50% for other closed door with informed host opening98 empties and locked it in.
observations.exploration: Play100 rounds at100 doors showed stay2/100,switch98/100. Guessing host1000 kept14 rounds,stay6/switch8. Picked Door1,informed host left Door47; switched47 and won,updating switch99/101 while stay2/100 unchanged.
observations.reveal: Corrected99%,explains original one-in100 and informed-host concentration of other99 chances. Cites actual strategy totals and guessing-host14,6/8 with small-count wobble. Notes three-door switch2/3.
observations.visual: Inline initial/guessing-host screenshots inspected:100-door grid,counters separately label informed strategies and kept random-host rounds. Door count selection,labels and controls legible. Trust5/5 ignored.
observations.isolation: No-history evaluation preview banner present. Visible trust count ignored.
observations.reference: Own CUA tab 543884122 snapshots and inspected inline screenshot; no screenshot file saved.

whyCool: Changing only the host's knowledge turns an overwhelming switching advantage into roughly even outcomes among the few random-host rounds that survive.
